# OpenSRM Service Reliability Manifest
# Migrated from legacy NthLayer format
# Original file: payment-api-partial-slas.yaml
#
# For more information, see:
# https://github.com/rsionnach/opensrm
#

apiVersion: srm/v1
kind: ServiceReliabilityManifest
metadata:
  name: payment-api
  team: payments-team
  tier: critical
spec:
  type: api
  slos:
    availability:
      target: 99.5
      window: 30d
  dependencies:
  - name: postgresql
    type: database
    critical: false
  - name: redis-cache
    type: database
    critical: false
  ownership:
    team: payments-team
